title: Sharing the Bill
story:
Four friends ate lunch at a small cafe after a long walk. The server brought one bill for the whole table. The total was forty-eight euros. Amir said they should divide it by four, so each person would pay twelve euros. Nia disagreed. She had ordered only soup, while the others had ordered full meals and drinks.

They asked the server for a moment and read the lines together. Nia's soup cost six euros. The three meals cost twelve euros each, and the drinks cost six euros altogether. Amir had ordered two drinks, and Luis had ordered one. Petra had not ordered a drink. An equal split would make Nia and Petra pay for things they had not chosen.

Amir suggested a fair share instead. Each person would pay for their own food, and each drink would be paid by the person who had it. Nia paid six euros. Petra paid twelve euros. Luis paid fourteen euros. Amir paid sixteen euros. Those amounts added up to forty-eight euros. They also left a tip of four euros, with one euro from each friend. The server said a clear bill keeps a table friendly. Nobody argued once the numbers were clear. Nia said she would rather pay her own part than argue later. They left the cafe talking about the walk, not about the money. The friends agreed to talk about the cost before they ordered next time.

The full cost of the lunch
A way to split a meal by four
quiz.correctAnswer: Extra money left for the server

quiz.supportingSentence: They also left a tip of four euros, with one euro from each friend.

quiz.question: How did the group seem once the payment was fair?

They were angry with the server
They decided never to eat together
They forgot to leave any extra money
quiz.correctAnswer: They were no longer worried about the cost
quiz.explanation: They left talking about the walk, so the money problem was over.
